mr_pyrex said:
To purify any substance such as meth from adultarants one of the first and most useful ways is to do a simple A/B extraction and the quick rundown of how to to do is as follows-->first you'll need toluene, sodium hydroxide(lye), sulfuric acid and salt...if you don't have access to these then you'll need to go another route and since I am short on time I'm not at this time going to go into explict details but rather the process instead...so you will need to know some chemistry on your part.
Basically what you do is to dissolve your impure substance meth/crap and mix with water....enough to dissolve all the substance completely and then add more water to dilute out the mixture...anything not dissolving should ideally be filtered out cause it ain't meth and you don't want it around. then next step is to basify the water/meth/crap solution and to do this you mix up some lye with water and do this slowly as heat is generated when mixing the two, by the way water should not be tap water...get bottled water...strength of the solution isn't terribly important.
Now once you have the lye solution you slowly add this to the water/meth/crap solution while stirring you will probably see the solution turn white momentarily as the meth falls out of solution and then redissolves...keep adding the lye solution until you start to see an oil floating on the surface of the mixture...then ad a bit more since you probably don't have ph papers for checking the ph which should be at 13+....what you have just done is to bring the water/meth/crap from a low ph up to the high 13+ ph and in doing so you have dropped the ph sensitive meth base out of solution which will leave behind non-ph sensitive compounds such as manitol or sugar and alot of other cuts. If you do not have a oil floating on top you either have NO meth in the starting material or you ph isn't high enoughin which case you can add more lye it really isn't going to do much to damage to the meth to overbasify.
Then you next step is too extract the meth via toluene...which is basically done by mixing a volume of toluene with the basified solution and then gnetly mixing together...GENTLY...not harshly as you'll cause emulsions which is another complete topic. But then do this extraction via toluene which three successive volumes of toluene...combine and dry the toluene if necessary(droplets of water forming on the bottom of the container).
Then next step is to recover the meth via coverting it to the hydrochloride form and this is done by genrating hydrogen chloride gas by combining salt and sulfuric acid in a suitable container and then ideally drying it through a container of more sulfuric acid...bubbling it through the sulfuric acid since sulfuric acid has a very large affinity for moisture and then bubbling the resulting gas through the toluene and watching the snow clouds appear like a winter blizzard. Such a beautiful and aw inspiring scene, never get tired of seeing it even after many hundreds of time. Assuming the meth gods smile upon you...but if you had oil floating on the basified solution the gods will smile upon you surely. Once you have the snowy toluene mixture all you need to do is to filter the solution through a coffee filter paper and let dry and you meth will be so pure that you won't even recognize it likely ;-)........
You just keep gassing it til you get no more snow or if you blow on the toluene and you get smokey fuming coming off it...which means it is saturated and you have gone plenty far enough and there will be no more meth appearing no more how much HCL gas you pump into the solvent. Well like I said this is the process and you need some chemistry knowledge to put this if to use otherwise this will be greek to you...and a good text to aquire would be Purification of Laboratory Chemicals or even better for the beginner would be The Organic Chemlab Survival Manual by Zubrick anyways thats all I got time for right now. If there is enough interest I could go into much further details but ya gotta let me know and I'll see if I can accomodate your request. Pyrex out of time;-)

All a panda knows is what a panda heard.

The acetone wash is used to separate cuts from methamphetamine by dissolving the cuts. If the acetone is pure (completely anhydrous and devoid of Bitrex and other additives), which is unlikely given the environment and equipment most pandas are working with, no product is lost if all the product is collected from the washing equipment (glass cups/beakers and the filter paper). Preparing non lab-grade acetone properly helps minimize losses, to the point where a panda doesn't mind due to the increase in quality.

Another wash being discussed by all sorts of pandas involves anhydrous alcohol-family solvents including denatured alcohol, ethanol, methanol, isopropyl, etc. However, in this wash the product is completely dissolved. This way, anything not dissolved is separated from the solvent since those things are not what pandas want. The pandas want what is currently in the alcohol solvent solution. The solvent used may be heated CAREFULLY as they are at the very least extremely flammable/volatile and perhaps even poison to pandas (i.e., methanol), to increase the solvent's ability to dissolve the product using a lower volume of solvent. For a given mass of product, there is an exact volume of solvent (which varies based on temperature) that will dissolve all of product. Any more solvent and there is no product dissolved in some of it, any less solvent and some of the product is not all dissolved. Using the minimal amount of solvent will yield something close to a supersaturated solution.

This solution is left undisturbed so that recrystallization can occur while the solvent evaporates out of the solution. If there were still undesirables left in the product that could not be separated using either the acetone or alcohol solvent, those undesirables will crystallize together just as the goodies crystallize together.

If the panda has any knowledge of melting/vaporization points, the panda knows that methamphetamine will melt somewhere around the 170 degrees Fahrenheit mark and vaporize at a higher temperature. The product first washed and then recrystallized could be evenly heated at a temperature lower than methamphetamine's melting point. Anything that melts or vaporizes below methamphetamine's melting point temperature is not what the panda wants, further cleaning what the panda has been doing all this work for.

Note: There are some things yet that these methods will not remove a panda's product, based on the method of synthesis and ne'er-do-welling of the alchemist. If the panda were to obtain the knowledge, equipment, ingredients, location, and unobserved/backed-by-alibi time to go after those, the panda would be ready to stop cleaning and simply start making messes.

Any panda not taking the time to research ends up in smoke and ashes or jumping through hoops in places pandas really don't like being kept for 20 years, right when the panda thought would succeed in generating a philosopher's stone and elixir of life in one. Pandas should always read and follow written directions on the bottle before the ones they read on the boards, and take note especially of words like "DANGER" "FLAMMABLE" and "POISON", the first usually preceding the others. Those warnings come on the end product as well as on the steps towards it.

A friends pet dolphin come up with this
Meth cleaning for dummies-
Acetone, even from hardware store is fine, grab some epsom salts cook 1 inch on baking pan in oven for 1 to 1.5 hours at 400f, now you have some drying agent for said hardware store acetone. Get your self a jar, fill about 3 quarters full with acetone, now add drying agent half spoon full at a time and shake, when first starting the drying agent will fall straight to bottom (thats water it is absorbing) keep adding and shaking until when you shake the dryin agent floats around like a snow globe. Then let all drying agent fall to bottom and decant acetone off slowly thru a funnel and two coffee filters into a new jar, be careful to keep the junk at the bottom out til the end. once u have decanted, throw away the rest. In your new jar u will have very close to 100% anhydrous or dry acetone. One could use this to do simple acetone wash, this will remove most if not all normal cuts. Keeping acetone in freezer for said washes is an added bonus.

A/B extraction works as well and was perfect work up on a/b early in this thread, props to the narrator, but it is alot of work and very easy to mess up and any organic material you would wish to have out will come over during this process as well, ie pse or eph.

If wanting to recrystallize, meth is soluble 1gr for 2ml water or 1gr for 3ml of alcohol, if u in mega rush, just use water but if you want mega crystals go the way of the alcohol; there is ways to add percentages of acetone, your newly dryed acetone to the alcohol solution to make the meth less soluble, the dolphin will give the tools you will have to figure out the ratios to make the crystals you wish to procure. You want what ever mix of alcohol/acetone or water to be extremely saturated, that means use less solution then its ideal solubility, ie for every 1gram of product use .55ml to 1ml of water, or 1 to 1.5 ml of alcohol with or without acetone the ratios will change. Now you will have to heat any solution in order to completely have your product soluble in your given solution( completely dissolved when hot say 100c area is what your looking for) once you have your solution hot and product completely dissolved just cover, do not touch it if you wish to have big crystals and let it cool to room temp, if you dont see crystals forming within 20 mins then you used to much solution, simply boil down a bit and let stand. If you are using alcohol putting it in the freezer after it is at room temp will continue crystals growing bigger and fatter. Alcohol recryst will take a good 6 hours and water can be done with in an hour. Once you are satisfied your product has recrystallized, simply decant remaining solution off really slowly into another large flat bottom glass or petri dish if one is handy DO NOT THROW OUT YOUR LEFT OVER SOLUTION, IT WILL HAVE SOME PRODUCT YOU ARE CRYSTALLIZING. Simply keep aside in wide mouthed glass or petri dish and let evaporate to recover all your product. Recrystallization is part science part art. this will further purify your product.
Enjoy

Acetone washes have been mostly ineffective in the past year or two due to the use of adulterants/cuts that have similar properties as those of methamphetamine hcl.

Recrystallization can help in removing some impurities, but is not a good method of removing cuts. The filtration of product dissolved in alcohol can help more than the recrystallization itself.
The reason for that is that assuming a cut will dissolve in alcohol and pass through the filter, chances are, it will also recrystallize, forming crystals that will end up either looking exactly like meth crystals, co-crystallizing with the meth, or crystallizing around the meth. How do you think methamp. hcl is "re-rocked" to begin with? Has anyone not seen giant shards that ended up being bunk?

An acetone wash with not-so-dry acetone might actually benefit some, if washing large crystals that were "dipped" in cutting agents, as the water dissolved in the acetone will dissolve the outside of the crystals, removing some cuts.

As a poster noted above (and this was news to me) beauty store acetone is much cleaner. THANK you for this tip, as I have noticed that hardware store acetone is not only wet, it contains other impurities as well - this can be tested by evaporating a bit of hardware store acetone and noticing that it leaves residue behind.

When doing an acetone wash, once you run the acetone through your dope, do not let the drop dry in the filter, as it will trap some paper fibers, and also cause product loss. Move it from the filter onto a glass plate and let it dry there.

OK, here is an update:

1) Do not use Acetone from the beauty store. I just went and purchased some "100% acetone" and it turns out that it contains an additive called denatonium benzoate which is meant to prevent accidental ingestion (and biting of nails) - this compound is known as the "most bitter substance known to man" and it is a salt. It will stay with your meth and make it taste really bad (my friend just contaminated a large batch this way)

2) It seems that the pH might have something to do with the potency, at least when smoked. My friend has been experimenting with A/B extraction, and cleaned some meth, then gassed it with Hcl. Then, he decided to try another route, and instead of bubbling the gas through it, he added muriatic to the freebase oil drop by drop, removed the remaining non-polar, and then evaporated the water which was part of the muriatic. This resulted in meth which was more acidic than normal.
The potency was like WOW, one hit and him and his wife were running around the house fixing this and that and just being very happy. Perhaps it was due to poisoning from the acid, who knows... but my friend told me that he noticed that sometimes he gets very potent stuff and a lot of the time it gives him acid reflux and is just more acidic than usual.
